c.14 Todas las personas que habitan esta vivienda, ¿dependen de un mismo fondo de alimentación? Es decir, ¿conforman un hogar?
d.16 ¿Este hogar paga (en dinero o de otra forma) a personas para que limpien la vivienda, cuiden niños o ancianos o realicen alguna otra tarea doméstica?

d.17 Sin mediar pago alguno, este hogar, ¿recibe ayuda de otros familiares o conocidos que no integran el hogar para limpiar la vivienda, cuidar niños o ancianos o para realizar alguna otra tarea doméstica?

assessments.reasoning: The survey uses pointer variables linking individuals directly to their mother (e.23), father (e.24), and spouse/partner (e.25) by person number, thereby recording relationships member-to-member rather than strictly relative to the reference person. Extended ties beyond spouse and parent-child (such as grandchildren, siblings, non-relatives, and same-sex partners) are explicitly captured in e.22 and e.26. The criterion for separating multiple households within a dwelling is stated in c.14 as depending on a common food budget ('mismo fondo de alimentación'). The presence of pointer variables for mother, father, and partner across all members allows family sub-units/nuclei within the household to be identified. However, caregiving relationships (mapping who provides care to whom, specifically identifying caregiver-receiver dyads inside or across households) are not recorded; questions d.16 and d.17 only ask at the aggregate household level about receiving or paying for care/domestic work.
